messages:
olivia: Quick sync — need a final call on embeddings API shape + batching for the upcoming enterprise pilot. Customer wants per-item metadata, stable ordering, and mixed model support (1024 & 3072 dims). Can we agree a contract?
rajesh: Quick Q: are we adding a new response shape or extending the existing one? We should avoid breaking light-weight clients.
maria: Suggestion: keep the current simple array response for backward compat but add an optional items list for richer metadata. Example: 
```
{
  \"items\": [
    {\"id\": \"req-1\", \"input\": \"docA\", \"embedding\": [0.12, -0.03, ...], \"meta\": {\"source\": \"s3://...\"}},
    {\"id\": \"req-2\", \"input\": \"docB\", \"embedding\": [0.11, -0.01, ...]}
  ],
  \"vector_dimensions\": 3072
}
```
This keeps order, gives ids for reconciliation, and lets us vary dims by model.
rajesh: That feels reasonable. For perf we need limits: proposed server-side hard cap 2048 vectors / request, API default cap 512. Ops can raise for Dedicated. Thoughts?
samir: Customer specifically asked to upload 10k docs in a single job. They can chunk on their side but we'd prefer a recommended client chunker. Can we provide a client helper in python + node? :+1:
olivia: We'll include a chunker snippet in the SDKs, yes. Product question: do we expose a param for response shape (compact vs detailed) or infer from presence of ids?
maria: expose format param: format=compact | format=objects. Compact = legacy array of vectors (fastest to parse). Objects = items with ids/meta. Default = compact for compatibility.
rajesh: Batching behavior: runtime can batch across requests but we need a deterministic per-request cost estimate. Proposal: bill by input count. Also add header X-Embeddings-Inputs to surface real request size to infra.
olivia: Launch criteria we agreed offline: (1) compatibility tests pass for existing customers; (2) SDK helpers published; (3) 99th p95 latency for 256-item calls < 400ms for small model, < 900ms for large on hosted; (4) docs and migration guide. Are we missing anything?
maria: Add quality/regression check: embedding cosine stability within 1e-3 after serialization and quantization profile tests for Dedicated.
samir: Also need an opt-in pilot flag so we can toggle for the enterprise customer while we watch usage.
rajesh: Implementation notes: runtime will accept mixed-dimension model param. If model dims != requested dims, return error. We should also support automatic downprojection in Optimize later but not in MVP.
olivia: Decision summary: 1) Keep legacy compact array response as default. 2) Add format=objects for id/meta/ordered items. 3) API caps: default 512 inputs/request, hard cap 2048 server-side, Dedicated override. 4) SDK chunker + migration guide. 5) Pilot opt-in toggle + metrics dashboard. 6) Launch criteria as listed. If no objections by EOD I'll move this into the PRD and tag eng work.
maria: No objections. I'll add perf benchmarks to the RFC.
samir: Sounds good — I'll coordinate pilot onboarding.
rajesh: I'll start the api-change PR and include compatibility tests and a fake client generator for load tests.
deploy-bot: deploy started ci/embeddings-api-shape-branch -> staging :rocket:
olivia: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap board and add a release checklist item for SDKs and migration samples. :sparkles:
